FACT_ID: sec17-R01 | anchor: A01
Correct the address on a vehicle registration within ten days after moving [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R02 | anchor: A01
An incorrect registration address can prevent delivery of renewal information. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R03 | anchor: A01
A plate applicant needs evidence of required liability coverage or an allowed substitute. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R04 | anchor: A01
Maintain insurance evidence in an operating vehicle and provide it when an officer requests it. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R05 | anchor: A01
The guide warns that inability to provide insurance proof can result in plate seizure and possible impoundment. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R06 | anchor: A01
Providing false insurance information can result in registration suspension and court penalties. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R07 | anchor: A01
Before canceling insurance on a vehicle that will no longer be used on the highway, the guide directs surrendering its plate to OMV. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R08 | anchor: A01
The registration certificate states the month and year in which the plate expires. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0141]

FACT_ID: sec17-R09 | anchor: A02
A registration renewal invitation is sent to the last address recorded with the agency. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec17-R10 | anchor: A02
Eligible owners can follow the renewal invitation’s instructions for online or telephone renewal. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec17-R11 | anchor: A02
Report renewal-application errors or address changes to the motor vehicle agency. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec17-R12 | anchor: A02
Receiving a renewal reminder is a courtesy; the owner remains responsible for valid registration. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec17-R13 | anchor: A02
The guide identifies authorized inspection stations by an orange sign naming the Louisiana motor vehicle inspection station. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec17-R14 | anchor: A02
The guide describes separate municipal inspection programs for New Orleans, Kenner and Westwego. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0142]

FACT_ID: sec17-R15 | anchor: A02
Contact your local Office of Motor Vehicles or visit its website for specific commercial vehicle, motorcycle, special plate and plate transfer fees [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0142]
